step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows a microservice application for Carano Fleet Management. Users interact with a web application hosted on S3 and send requests through API Gateway. API Gateway routes requests to Lambda functions or ECS containers running Kotlin/Vert.x services. ECS publishes messages to SNS for fanout, which forwards them to SQS queues (fan-in), from which SQS triggers/delivers messages to Lambda functions and ECS instances. DynamoDB is also visually present on the board as a database store.
